feature: COOP-049 Native Job Opportunities via Agent UI + EVEmail
prerequisites: Two real accounts, active native ships, actual corporate agent in same solar system as live preparing NPC convoy
Existing paid Escort funding gates separately proved before enabling payouts

finance: EVEJS_COOP_ESCORT_PEACEFUL_PAYOUT (DO NOT ENABLE UNTIL FULL FINANCE E2E)
crashRecovery: EVEJS_COOP_ESCORT_NATIVE_WARP_RECOVERY=1 (EXPERIMENTAL/DEFAULT OFF, requires genuine active native ingress and all Stage I proof flags)
Never enable on live persistent data before 2-client crash/recovery validation
nativeIngressSnapshot: EVEJS_COOP_ESCORT_NATIVE_INGRESS_SNAPSHOT=1 (EXPERIMENTAL default-OFF; genuine physical ingress, original WARP_ACK and durable witness)
All strict native Escort/warehouse/wallet flags required; ONLY use disposable 2-client GameStore E2E
nativeDeliveryRecovery: EVEJS_COOP_ESCORT_NATIVE_DELIVERY_RECOVERY=1 (DEFAULT OFF; only with confirmed original active warp and actual native ingress snapshot)
Requires existing EVEJS_COOP_ESCORT_NATIVE_WARP_RECOVERY=1 and strict Stage I and atomic corporate escrow flags
No live usage before genuine two-client warehouse + atomic real wallet E2E passes
peacefulDurableReplay: EVEJS_COOP_ESCORT_PEACEFUL_REPLAY=1 (DEFAULT OFF; requires authentic source, two midroute points and terminal original two-pilot fsync)
EVEJS_COOP_ESCORT_PEACEFUL_PAYOUT=1 plus EVEJS_COOP_ESCORT_ROUTE_WITNESS=1 and all existing native escrow and two-player attendance flags required
Startup scans up to 32 original DELIVERED native journals; no client API or synthetic attendance
Run ONLY after original disposable GameStore dual-wallet E2E passes

scenarios.name: Authentic live corporate offer appears
actions: Observe real cargo/hauler/route/quote on native backend
Player opens Agents list and contacts real NPC agent of issuing corporation
Inspect EVE agent dialogue and briefing
scenarios.expected: Agent describes same real convoy and quoted reward; never says already funded

scenarios.name: Native Accept buttons replace slash commands
actions: Two pilots join stock native fleet and enter actual live system
Each opens agent conversation and presses native Accept
First may reconfirm after second opted in
scenarios.expected: Original server-stored native two-pilot signed receipt; never grants immediate ISK

scenarios.name: Only genuine agents can offer
actions: Contact real other-corporation agent
Contact a different-system agent
Contact agent with native mission already offered/active
scenarios.expected: Unchanged normal missions, no cross-corporation fake offers

scenarios.name: No matching SDE station agent fallback
actions: Prepare real convoy without matching real same-system corporate agent
Check local opted-in client's standard EVEmail
scenarios.expected: In-game A-Life event mail remains available, clearly UNPAID; no false Agent ID

scenarios.name: Native quoted agent EVEmail
actions: Opt in to local job notices
Generate real priced convoy from verified corporate native wallet
Open stock EVEmail and agent contact
scenarios.expected: Accurate agent ID, system/station and actual nonreserved quote; no need to type /jobs

scenarios.name: Watch local/all/off and anti-spam
actions: Opt out one character
Other watches local
Third distant watches all
Replay same quote and reboot
scenarios.expected: Only eligible online recipients; at-most-one quote mail per character/source

scenarios.name: Lost EVEmail ACK
actions: Inject lost native mail ACK on disposable test world
Replay quote
Restart server
scenarios.expected: No duplicate sent mail; uncertain delivery requires operator review

scenarios.name: Native agent Accept without opening dialog
actions: Try stale stock Accept after restart on the same bound agent
scenarios.expected: Fail closed without randomly selecting a new convoy or stock mission

scenarios.name: Offer changed between View/Accept
actions: Open agent's native quote
Deliver, expire or replace cargo before pressing Accept
scenarios.expected: No silent selection switch, no ISK debit, explicit reopen or repair instruction

scenarios.name: Persistent actor-agent selection
actions: Open offer as pilot A
Restart native service
Press Accept from old agent dialog
Try another character or another agent
scenarios.expected: Exact originally selected source only; unique native character-agent binding survives restart

scenarios.name: Selection corrupt/rename crash
actions: On disposable clone, corrupt selection JSON
Place an abandoned tmp file from simulated failed expired rotation
Attempt native Accept and reopen
scenarios.expected: Fail closed / operator repair; no native wallet or mission writes

scenarios.name: Real convoy peacefully delivered
actions: Both characters physically escort one true NPC hauler
Native cargo fully lands and is verified in station warehouse
Inspect corporate/player wallets before/after and after reconnect
scenarios.expected: Existing escrow exactly-once payout, no pirate kill mandatory; this financial gate remains OFF until approved

scenarios.name: Reversible overlay and native protocol
actions: Run patch --dry-run against exact pinned local checkout
Patch to disposable checkout, inspect AgentMgr / stock agent dialogue
Remove then compare hashes of original upstream files
scenarios.expected: No drift, byte-exact removal, button Accept visible and functional inside actual EVE 24.01 client

scenarios.name: Legacy path unchanged
actions: Run EVE native mission from different agent and direct /events legacy dev interface
Run normal mission acceptance/decline/completion
Run with all new job flags OFF
scenarios.expected: No regression to native agent missions, original economy/legacy NPC events preserved

scenarios.name: UI player-language acceptance
actions: Check in-game agent display and email in client's configured locale
Check long text, line breaks, actions, no missing localization keys
scenarios.expected: Native UI actually renders; if client rejects custom strings fallback to truthful EVEmail and agent-native static dialogue only

scenarios.name: Paid peaceful escort requires real duo on-grid BEFORE escrow
actions: Two authentic players accept the quoted job with stock agent buttons
Move one player's real ship farther than 150 km from original NPC hauler
Trigger actual native prewarp departure
scenarios.expected: No funded native contract and no NPC warp: on-grid departure witness denied, no escrow debit

scenarios.name: Exactly one durable on-grid witness survives restart
actions: Both ships position within 150 km of original NPC and join genuine fleet
Native source record is fsynced before corporate escrow and warp
Restart server after genuine warp
Verify native full cargo delivery with both original pilots at terminal
scenarios.expected: No new source witness or second warp; settlement requires preserved original manifest-linked source witness AND original terminal attendance

scenarios.name: Source attendance witness corrupt/symlink/lost ACK
actions: On operator-approved disposable data clone, corrupt witness journal
Replace witness with symlink/hardlink
Inject lost fsync ACK and repeat request
scenarios.expected: No authorization to reserve, launch or pay from corrupt/linked/uncertain witness; human operator repair required

scenarios.name: Off-grid pilot rejected before native manifest or debit
actions: Two distinct genuine pilots accept same corporate escort quote
Move one real ship beyond 150km of source NPC while preserving its paid acceptance
Attempt station convoy start; inspect original native manifest directory and GameStore escrow table
scenarios.expected: Server denies ESCORT_DEPARTURE_PILOT_NOT_ON_NPC_GRID; no original native manifest prepared, no corporation ISK reserved and no warp command dispatched

scenarios.name: Two genuine players escort two observable midroute waypoints
actions: Enable Stage I only on disposable EVEJS snapshot and real 2-client server
Accept original source-linked real NPC corporate quote via stock Agent UI with two different authenticated pilots
Observe native server tick while real hauler crosses 20-45% and 55-85% of the actual source-to-station vector with both ships within 10 km
Confirm full native cargo warehouse delivery, original two-pilot terminal presence, atomic native wallet settlement
scenarios.expected: Exactly one original corporate escrow and two immutable unique stage receipts; route witness source validated with real scene positions; exactly one two-pilot native wallet settlement, no extra ISK

scenarios.name: AFK station camper cannot earn route-certified escort wage
actions: Accept two-player job and sign original departure source witness
One player remains parked at target station while NPC leaves source
Observe genuine native NPC midroute tick positions
Complete physical warehouse cargo delivery
scenarios.expected: At least one checkpoint missing; strict Stage I prevents peaceful wallet settlement; cargo delivery is still real and not rewritten

scenarios.name: Real player disconnect, ship swap or changed native fleet blocks checkpoint
actions: Record one genuine transit checkpoint
Disconnect one participant, duplicate their session or change their real ship/fleet
Allow NPC to continue crossing second checkpoint
scenarios.expected: Second stage NOT durably recorded; original signed pilot cannot be replaced from client input; no payout from invalid two-checkpoint claim

scenarios.name: Fast native warp without observable middle positions is NOT entitled to guessed payout
actions: Use actual pinned NPC warp duration and destination with 2 EVE clients
Instrument number and positions of actual coopNativeStationArrival.tick callbacks
Observe whether 20-45% and 55-85% windows occur before terminal cargo delivery
scenarios.expected: If either real midpoint cannot be sampled, strict Stage I reports missing evidence and refuses payout; disable Stage I until genuine movement tick integration verified, do not generate samples by timer

scenarios.name: Source-linked route checkpoint corrupted or crash ACK uncertain
actions: On disposable operator clone persist first midroute witness
Inject lost file/directory fsync ACK, symlink/hardlink or corrupt checkpoint then restart
Resume original native trip and attempt terminal settlement
scenarios.expected: No fabricated completion or blind rewrite; file+dir re-fsync required for immutable original receipts; corrupt/linked evidence blocks payout for operator repair

scenarios.name: Pinned real native movement callback emits two authoritative escort route checkpoints
actions: Run pinned EveJS Docker with two genuinely distinct EVE clients on disposable world snapshot
Enable peaceful Escort, source witness, strict route witness, and native warp observer flags
Take actual NPC agent contract with two real ships and original accepted corporate price
Observe stock advanceSessionlessWarpIngress NPC scene position callbacks, actual six-beat ingress, exact two signed player positions near hauler at 20-45% and 55-85% route progress
Verify original two checkpoint journal files then full terminal warehouse cargo and genuine atomic GameStore wallet deltas
scenarios.expected: Original stock NPC physical interpolation triggers exactly validated native observer samples, both same-authentic-fleet player ships progress with NPC within 10km, two durable route checkpoints exist and exactly one funded corporate two-player payout; no guessed or replayed positions

scenarios.name: Missing native observer or short route must not reserve corporate ISK
actions: On disposable two-client native job enable strict route witness but disable native warp observer
Attempt paid original NPC convoy departure and inspect native cargo manifest and actual corporate wallet
Enable observer and change source-to-actual-station distance to less than 10km in a controlled fixture
Attempt paid convoy again
scenarios.expected: ESCORT_NATIVE_MOTION_OBSERVER_REQUIRED or ESCORT_ROUTE_TOO_SHORT_FOR_WITNESS before manifest creation, original corporation escrow or warp; no stranded paid quote and no invented midpoint

scenarios.name: Restart while original NPC is still in real paid Escort warp
actions: Use disposable world snapshot and 2 real authenticated EVE clients with all experimental Stage I flags and EVEJS_COOP_ESCORT_NATIVE_WARP_RECOVERY=1
Accept original NPC corporate paid job, obtain original cargo manifest, genuine source duo witness and native WARP_ACK_CONFIRMED journal
Restart only the server while native NPC still has restorable sessionlessWarpIngress and unchanged cargo
Observe stock native NPC movement callback after restored SpaceScene tick
scenarios.expected: Read-only resume matches original funded flight, WARP_ACK_CONFIRMED, preserved hauler cargo, original duo departure proof and unchanged physical ingress, continues sampling only physically observed midroute points; NO second escrow, warp or contract; missing observation fails closed

scenarios.name: Restart with prepared-only/unknown ACK or changed source evidence
actions: On disposable crash-injection clone stop after WARP_PREPARED without durable native ACK, or replace cargo/ship/source receipt/target station
Enable recovery flag and run native NPC movement callback
Inspect original escrow reserve and native warp command count
scenarios.expected: No reattachment and NO new movement, payments or warp dispatch from ambiguous ACK or mismatched provenance; manual repair required

scenarios.name: Restart after NPC ingress is finished or state absent
actions: Finish the original native NPC warp before restarting
Restart server and leave recovery enabled, but do not fabricate sessionlessWarpIngress
Trigger normal station delivery tick with both real pilots and original warehouse
scenarios.expected: Native recovery observer refuses to invent missing midroute observations. Existing cargo/warehouse may be independently valid, but strict Stage I does not award players absent two real checkpoints.

scenarios.name: Real original NPC ingress after durable ACK survives a short native process crash
actions: On a disposable original pinned EveJS world with 2 EVE clients enable Stage I, recovery and ingress-snapshot flags
Start a real paid corporate Escort from stock in-game Agent; verify source witness and exactly one genuine WARP_ACK_CONFIRMED
Confirm snapshot under original protected coop-native warehouse root records actual sessionlessWarpIngress and has fsynced file and parent
Kill the server during the 6-30s native ingress; restart within original remaining ingress time
Materialize original same native NPC with stored position matching its original physical source; measure true movement and wallet table
scenarios.expected: Only the original verified NPC ingress is restored, no new warpToPoint, no new native corporate escrow reservation and no generated route evidence; any recovered checkpoint still requires two genuinely moving authenticated player ships

scenarios.name: Expired original ingress, missing ACK or mismatched persistent NPC state fails closed
actions: Replay same original checkpoint with server restart after ingress expiry, or only a WARP_PREPARED journal
Change the persisted native NPC position, target station, cargo or original contract on controlled cloned fixture
Observe physical materialization and original wallet, mission, cargo journals
scenarios.expected: No physical ingress is resurrected, no NPC teleport, no second reservation or reward, no invented mid-route points; operator repair rather than replay

scenarios.name: Pinned NPC materialization hook must survive controller initialization and reverse cleanly
actions: Run Run-NativeJob-Tests.ps1 -CheckPinned against original pinned Code checkout
Install overlay on an offline clone, restart a persistent native NPC under snapshot opt-in, and inspect its real mode/ingress after controller initialization
Run reversible --remove and compare pinned original nativeNpcService.js byte-for-byte
scenarios.expected: One source hook after controller/ambient state setup only; NPC original warp state preserves stock physical interpolation; exact pinned source restored after removal

scenarios.name: Corporate escrow survives snapshot storage failure with no invented proof
actions: With disposable native GameStore inject fsync failure while writing immutable ingress snapshot after true ACK
Inspect returned ingressSnapshotStatus, native wallet deltas, physical NPC position and repeat attempts
Restart without a verified snapshot
scenarios.expected: Only original pre-funded escrow exists; no second funding/warp on retry; snapshot failure cannot permit automatic ingress reconstruction or fictitious payout; requires manual resolution

scenarios.name: Two-client crash restores original native Escort terminal delivery, not just NPC warp
actions: On disposable pinned EveJS Docker clone with genuine 2 authenticated player ships, enable all Stage I native escrow/witness/warp flags and EVEJS_COOP_ESCORT_NATIVE_DELIVERY_RECOVERY=1
Start original paid NPC haul via stock in-game Agent and collect original native source/cargo, WARP_ACK and ingress snapshot before crashing
Restart only while original ingress is unexpired and verify original NPC materializes with same sessionlessWarpIngress
Allow both original real pilots to follow NPC through recorded stage checkpoints and continue NPC to canonical stock station
Verify scene checkReturn reconstructs original coopStationArrival from original funded flight/snapshot and true warehouse commits original cargo exactly once
Verify one native terminal ledger event and exactly two atomically settled original character ISK credits
scenarios.expected: No new warpToPoint, NPC materialization, original escrow reservation or duplicated cargo; original source manifest reconciles, cargo reaches real warehouse and only real attended service unlocks native money

scenarios.name: Unverified original physical ingress never triggers a new predeparture during crash recovery
actions: On disposable clone leave original warp only WARP_PREPARED or replace protected signed source, original cargo or snapshot
Restart server with original still-warping NPC and old preparatory Agent notice ID
Inspect native ship positions, native warp call counts and original corporate/character wallet tables
scenarios.expected: Fail closed with explicit ESCORT_DELIVERY_RESUME reason; no new command to warp, no new escrow reserve, no invented first or second route checkpoint

scenarios.name: Stale A-Life no-cargo hint cannot erase genuine proven native haul
actions: After short crash recover an original accepted native cargo flight with both original verified players and durable ingress
Simulate leftover fleet.coopStationNoCargo=true from pre-restart A-Life state
Run native checkReturn and verify original loaded ship/cargo and station progress
scenarios.expected: Only a full independently verified original in-flight manifest may clear stale no-cargo hint; ordinary empty NPC or invalid ACK retains normal fail-closed behavior

scenarios.name: True terminal warehouse proof invalid means no player ISK after restart
actions: On disposable native clone resume genuine NPC warp but inject a missing warehouse cargo stack or mismatched manifest proof
Let NPC physically reach the original station with both fleet ships near it
Inspect true original warehouse, GameStore credits and original corporate escrow
scenarios.expected: Full manifest mismatch blocks native recordDelivered and atomic player settlement; no fabricated cargo, no second ISK reserve, repair required

scenarios.name: Post-delivery peaceful payout after both real players disconnect
actions: Use disposable pinned EveJS server with 2 independently authenticated original player ships and strict peaceful-replay flag
Accept original native NPC Agent contract, follow original NPC through actual two route checkpoints
Reach original stock station with both players and verify genuine warehouse full-manifest receipt
Observe original fsynced terminal two-player attendance written before durable flight DELIVERED journal
Disconnect both clients and crash/restart server before wallet ACK; run trusted reconciliation scan
scenarios.expected: Server reads only original fsynced source+route+terminal evidence and original delivery, verifies escrow RESERVED, atomically credits both original characters once. No reconnect/client claim, duplicate cargo or second NPC warp required.

scenarios.name: Unknown atomic wallet ACK must never double-credit players
actions: In a disposable GameStore clone inject lost ACK after real atomic dual-player credit but before game application response
Restart native server with same original delivery and terminal attendance receipts
Run native peaceful reconciliation twice and inspect real GameStore transaction IDs and wallet deltas
scenarios.expected: Native verifySettlement resolves ALREADY_NATIVE_PAID both times. Exactly one original corporate reserve consumed and each original player credited exactly once, no additional 2 credits.

scenarios.name: No source, no original midpoint, wrong pilot, or missing terminal cannot mint peaceful ISK
actions: Inject on a disposable snapshot each absent/corrupt original source, first or second route receipt, wrong source ship, absent second terminal pilot, fsync-uncertain terminal receipt
Confirm genuine terminal warehouse delivery is still accounted once
Trigger offline reconciliation and compare native corporation escrow and both character wallets
scenarios.expected: Every missing or inconsistent original proof denies automatic payout. No synthetic attendance after delivery, no fabricated route proof, no unverified refund or wallet double spend; operator repair needed.

scenarios.name: Reconciliation scan cannot use untrusted player job IDs or pay undelivered flight
actions: Supply a client-provided random manifest and an original FUNDED-but-not-DELIVERED escrow on cloned native server
Attempt ordinary in-game calls and then actual trusted server-side peaceful reconciliation
Observe secure flight journal enumeration, original wallet and real warehouse
scenarios.expected: Only fully fsynced original DELIVERED flight journals are candidates; an untrusted manifest or incomplete original cargo never enters native settleAtomic; scan limits and incorrect flags fail closed.
